edges.reason: Constructor mints the total supply to the caller msg.sender.
_msgSender() supplies the sender for transfer/transferFrom into _transfer.
enableTrading stores block.timestamp into _launchTime, creating timestamp dependency.
_transfer compares block.timestamp to _launchTime to flag sniper addresses at launch.
_transfer uses tx.origin as the key for the per-block transfer delay check.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline in _swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline in _addLiquidity.
withdrawFees sends the contract balance to the feeWallet state variable.
Owner-controlled updateFeeWallet writes the feeWallet address.
maxTransactionAmount is enforced against the transfer amount in _transfer.
maxWallet is enforced against recipient balance in _transfer.
_isSniper mapping is read and written inside _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFees is read in _transfer to decide fee application.
automatedMarketMakerPairs determines buy/sell branches inside _transfer.
_tokensForLiquidity is consumed by swapBack when computing liquidity tokens.
_tokensForMarketing is consumed by swapBack when computing ETH shares.
_tokensForDev is consumed by swapBack when computing ETH shares.
swapTokensAtAmount caps the contract balance used in swapBack.
buyTotalFees is used to compute fees on buys in _transfer.
sellTotalFees is used to compute fees on sells in _transfer.
The transfer amount parameter feeds the fee and amount -= fees arithmetic.
The computed fees local feeds the amount reduction arithmetic.
The computed fees local is split into the _tokensFor* accumulators.
_swapTokensForEth arguments flow into the external router swap call.
_addLiquidity arguments flow into the external router addLiquidityETH call.
withdrawFees triggers the ETH transfer to feeWallet.
newAmount parameter is validated and stored by updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
newNum parameter is validated and stored by updateMaxTxnAmount.
newWallet parameter becomes the new feeWallet.
updAds parameter is written into the max transaction exclusion mapping.
snipers_ array entries are written into the _isSniper mapping.
tokenAmount local defines how many tokens are swapped.
ethAmount local defines the ETH value for the liquidity call.
contractBalance local drives the swapBack token split.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against transfer participants as an AMM pair.
uniswapV2Router is the call target for _swapTokensForEth.
uniswapV2Router is the call target for _addLiquidity.
Owner-controlled updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount.
Owner-controlled updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.
Owner-controlled updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
enableTrading flips the tradingActive gate.
enableTrading records the launch timestamp.
removeLimits disables limitsInEffect.
disableTransferDelay disables transferDelayEnabled.
setSnipers writes sniper flags into _isSniper.
delSnipers clears sniper flags in _isSniper.
excludeFromFees updates the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
excludeFromMaxTransaction updates the exclusion mapping.
updateBuyFees recomputes and stores buyTotalFees.
updateSellFees recomputes and stores sellTotalFees.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates writing to the private helper.
_transfer invokes swapBack while _swapping and _swapping guard the reentry path.
swapBack calls _swapTokensForEth to convert tokens to ETH.
swapBack calls _addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH are available.
The _swapping flag gates entry into swapBack.
The _swapping flag also disables fee taking and limit checks in _transfer.
limitsInEffect gates the anti-whale branch in _transfer.
tradingActive is required for non-excluded transfers.
transferDelayEnabled gates the per-block purchase restriction.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp is read/written using tx.origin during the delay check.
takeFee local gates whether fee arithmetic executes.
Router swap performs token transfers that can re-enter the token contract.
Router addLiquidityETH performs token transfers that can re-enter the token contract.
Outgoing ETH transfer to feeWallet is caught by the receive function if it is a contract.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newAmount is only consumed by updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
Parameter newNum is only consumed by the max limit setters such as updateMaxTxnAmount.
Parameter newWallet is only consumed by updateFeeWallet.
Parameter updAds is only consumed by excludeFromMaxTransaction.
Parameter snipers_ is only consumed by setSnipers/delSnipers.
Parameter amount is the transfer amount handled by _transfer.
Parameter from is the sender handled by _transfer.
Parameter to is the recipient handled by _transfer.
Local tokenAmount is only used inside _swapTokensForEth.
Local ethAmount is only used inside _addLiquidity.
Local contractBalance is only used inside swapBack.
Local fees is computed and applied inside _transfer.
Local takeFee only gates fee logic inside _transfer.
